groups.name: modular
groups.description: Henge: which @ModularService versions this process embeds, and how it reaches the others.

groups.name: modular.services
groups.description: Per service, by name: modular.services.<name>.mode (embedded | internal-rest) and .url, overridable per version as modular.services.<name>.versions.<n>.mode / .url. Unrecognized keys or service names fail startup.

groups.name: modular.leases
groups.description: Per lease, by name: modular.leases.<lease>.capacity, the cluster-wide capacity services share out with @RequiresLease. What one instance of a service claims is modular.services.<name>.leases.<lease>.

groups.name: modular.server
groups.description: The /_modular dispatch endpoint this process serves.

groups.name: modular.transport
groups.description: The internal-rest client and its shared secret.

properties.name: modular.serve
properties.description: name[@version] entries naming what this process hosts; every other discovered service defaults to internal-rest. Names that match no @ModularService fail startup.

properties.name: modular.remote-url-template
properties.description: URL for any internal-rest service without an explicit url, with {service} and {version} substituted, e.g. http://{service}.default.svc.cluster.local:8080. Other placeholders fail startup.

properties.name: modular.server.enabled
properties.description: Whether this process serves /_modular at all (a non-web application never does).

properties.name: modular.server.path-prefix
properties.description: Path prefix of the dispatch endpoint, for both the server and the client side. Must start with '/' and not end with one.

properties.name: modular.transport.secret
properties.description: Optional shared secret, sent as the Modular-Internal-Secret header and required by the dispatcher; with Spring Security it becomes an authentication. Unset is supported: the network is the boundary.

properties.name: modular.transport.connect-timeout
properties.description: Connect timeout of internal-rest calls. A bare number is milliseconds; 0 means no timeout.

properties.name: modular.transport.read-timeout
properties.description: Read timeout of internal-rest calls. A bare number is milliseconds; 0 means no timeout.
